description: This file defines the PasswordExpirationService class in the SuiteCRM project, responsible for generating password expiration messages and managing related configurations.

classes.name: PasswordExpirationService
classes.description: Service class providing password expiration message handling and configuration management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with global configuration and language strings.

methods.name: getExpirationMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a message indicating password expiration status with a link to the password management page.

methods.name: setExpiration
methods.description: Resets password expiration settings in the configuration and writes changes to the config file.
